macros.name: CurrentLocaleCurrencyPattern
macros.doc: This is a convenient shortcut to access the currency pattern for the current dialect.

macros.name: CurrentLocaleDayIndexFromRegion
macros.doc: This is a shortcut for \LocaleDayIndexFromRegion{〈dialect〉}{〈index〉}.

macros.name: CurrentLocaleDecimalPattern
macros.doc: This is a convenient shortcut to access the decimal pattern for the current dialect.

macros.name: CurrentLocaleIntegerPattern
macros.doc: This is a convenient shortcut to access the integer pattern for the current dialect.

macros.name: CurrentLocalePercentPattern
macros.doc: This is a convenient shortcut to access the percent pattern for the current dialect.

macros.name: CurrentLocaleShortMonthName
macros.doc: This is a shortcut for \LocaleShortMonthName{〈dialect〉}{〈index〉}.

macros.name: CurrentLocaleStandaloneMonthName
macros.doc: This is a shortcut for \LocaleStandaloneMonthName{〈dialect〉}{〈index〉}.

macros.name: CurrentLocaleStandaloneShortMonthName
macros.doc: This is a shortcut for \LocaleStandaloneShortMonthName{〈dialect〉}{〈index〉}.

macros.name: dtmFridayIndex
macros.doc: This expands to 4, the index for Friday.

macros.name: dtmMondayIndex
macros.doc: This expands to 0, the index for Monday.

macros.name: dtmSaturdayIndex
macros.doc: This expands to 5, the index for Saturday.

macros.name: dtmSundayIndex
macros.doc: This expands to 6, the index for Sunday.

macros.name: dtmThursdayIndex
macros.doc: This expands to 3, the index for Thursday.

macros.name: dtmTuesdayIndex
macros.doc: This expands to 1, the index for Tuesday.

macros.name: dtmWednesdayIndex
macros.doc: This expands to 2, the index for Wednesday.

macros.name: LocaleAddToAttributeList
macros.doc: Adds 〈value〉 to this attribute’s list (without repetition).

macros.name: LocaleAddToCurrencyAttributeList
macros.doc: Adds 〈value〉 to this attribute’s list (without repetition).

macros.name: LocaleAddToDialectAttributeList
macros.doc: Adds 〈value〉 to this attribute’s list (without repetition).

macros.name: LocaleAddToRegionAttributeList
macros.doc: Adds 〈value〉 to this attribute’s list (without repetition).

macros.name: LocaleCurrencyLabel
macros.doc: Gets the currency label for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleCurrencySymbol
macros.doc: Gets the currency symbol for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleCurrencyTeXSymbol
macros.doc: Gets the currency symbol for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleDateTimeInfo
macros.doc: The value of this command contains all the information for the current date-time provided in a format that can easily be parsed by date or time patterns.

macros.name: LocaleDayIndexFromOneMonToZeroMon
macros.doc: This converts a day index from the ISO-8601 Monday=1 (Sunday=7) based system to the Monday=0 (Sunday=6) based system.

macros.name: LocaleDayIndexFromOneSunToZeroMon
macros.doc: This converts a day index from the Sunday=1 based system to the Monday=0 based system.

macros.name: LocaleDayIndexFromRegion
macros.doc: This converts the region’s day of the week (starting from 1 for the region’s first day) to Monday=0 based indexing.

macros.name: LocaleDayIndexFromZeroMonToOneMon
macros.doc: This converts a day index from the Monday=0 (Sunday=6) based system to the ISO-8601 Monday=1 (Sunday=7) based system.

macros.name: LocaleDayIndexFromZeroMonToOneSun
macros.doc: This converts a day index from the Monday=0 based system to the Sunday=1 based system.

macros.name: LocaleDayName
macros.doc: Gets the day of week name identified by the index 〈n〉 (0 for Monday, 1 for Tuesday, etc) in the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleFirstDayIndex
macros.doc: Get the index for the first day of the week for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleForEachInAttributeList
macros.doc: This iterates over each element of the list, setting the control sequence 〈cs〉 to the current item and performing 〈body〉.

macros.name: LocaleForEachInCurrencyAttributeList
macros.doc: Where an attribute value is a comma-separated list, this iterates over each item in that list, setting 〈cs〉 to that item and performing 〈body〉.

macros.name: LocaleForEachInDialectAttributeList
macros.doc: Where an attribute value is a comma-separated list, this iterates over each item in that list, setting 〈cs〉 to that item and performing 〈body〉.

macros.name: LocaleForEachInRegionAttributeList
macros.doc: Where an attribute value is a comma-separated list, this iterates over each item in that list, setting 〈cs〉 to that item and performing 〈body〉.

macros.name: LocaleFullDate
macros.doc: Get the full date for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleFullDateTime
macros.doc: This displays the full date and time for the locale identified by 〈dialect〉 as provided by texosquery.

macros.name: LocaleFullTime
macros.doc: Get the full time for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleGetCurrencyAttribute
macros.doc: Gets currency attribute.

macros.name: LocaleGetDialectAttribute
macros.doc: Gets dialect attribute.

macros.name: LocaleGetRegionAttribute
macros.doc: Gets region attribute.

macros.name: LocaleIfHasLanguageName
macros.doc: Determines if the given dialect has a language name.

macros.name: LocaleIfHasRegionName
macros.doc: Determines if the given dialect has a region name.

macros.name: LocaleIfHasVariantName
macros.doc: Determines if the given dialect has a variant name.

macros.name: LocaleIfInAttributeList
macros.doc: This does 〈true〉 if 〈item〉 is found in the 〈attribute〉 list for 〈label〉, otherwise it does 〈false〉.

macros.name: LocaleIfInCurrencyAttributeList
macros.doc: Where an attribute value is a comma-separated list, this tests if 〈item〉 is in that list.

macros.name: LocaleIfInDialectAttributeList
macros.doc: Where an attribute value is a comma-separated list, this tests if 〈item〉 is in that list.

macros.name: LocaleIfInRegionAttributeList
macros.doc: Where an attribute value is a comma-separated list, this tests if 〈item〉 is in that list.

macros.name: LocaleIfNumericUsesGroup
macros.doc: This does 〈true code〉 if the locale identified by 〈dialect〉 uses a number group separator otherwise it does 〈false code〉.

macros.name: LocaleLanguageName
macros.doc: Get the language name of the given dialect according to the OS default language.

macros.name: LocaleLanguageNativeName
macros.doc: Get the language name of the given dialect according to that dialect.

macros.name: LocaleLanguageTag
macros.doc: Expands to the language tag for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleLongDate
macros.doc: Get the long date for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleLongDateTime
macros.doc: Get the long date and time for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleLongTime
macros.doc: Get the long time for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleMain
macros.doc: This macro stores the language tag of the document’s main region or locale to use the OS locale.

macros.name: LocaleMainDialect
macros.doc: This expands to the main locale’s dialect label.

macros.name: LocaleMainRegion
macros.doc: This expands to the main locale’s region.

macros.name: LocaleMediumDate
macros.doc: Get the medium date for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleMediumDateTime
macros.doc: Get the medium date and time for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleMediumTime
macros.doc: Get the medium time for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleMonthName
macros.doc: Gets the month name identified by the index 〈n〉 (1 for January, 2 for February, etc) in the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleNowStamp
macros.doc: This expands to the current date-time in PDF format.

macros.name: LocaleNumericDecimalSep
macros.doc: Gets the numeric decimal separator for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleNumericExponent
macros.doc: Gets the exponent symbol for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleNumericGroupSep
macros.doc: Gets the numeric group separator for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleNumericMonetarySep
macros.doc: Gets the numeric monetary separator for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleNumericPercent
macros.doc: Gets the percent symbol for this dialect.

macros.name: LocaleNumericPermill
macros.doc: Gets the permill symbol for this dialect.

macros.name: localenumfmt
macros.doc: The \localenumfmt command splits up 〈decimal〉 into the 〈int part〉, 〈frac part〉 and 〈mantissa〉 required by \texosqueryfmtnumber.

macros.name: localenumfmtneg
macros.doc: Wrapper for negative values.

macros.name: localenumfmtpos
macros.doc: Wrapper for positive values.

macros.name: localenumfmtzero
macros.doc: Wrapper for zero values.

macros.name: LocaleOSarch
macros.doc: This expands to the architecture.

macros.name: LocaleOScodeset
macros.doc: This expands to the operating system’s default file encoding (or the value of the Java setting file.encoding).

macros.name: LocaleOSname
macros.doc: This expands to the operating system name.

macros.name: LocaleOStag
macros.doc: This expands to the operating system’s language tag, but note that this doesn’t mean that this locale has been tracked (either as the main locale or one of the other document locales).

macros.name: LocaleOSversion
macros.doc: This expands to the operating system version.

macros.name: LocaleOther
macros.doc: This macro stores a comma-separated list of language tags or locale for additional regions.

macros.name: LocaleRegionName
macros.doc: Get the region name of the given dialect according to the OS default language.

macros.name: LocaleRegionNativeName
macros.doc: Get the region name of the given dialect according to that dialect.

macros.name: LocaleSetCurrencyAttribute
macros.doc: Sets currency attribute.

macros.name: LocaleSetDialectAttribute
macros.doc: Sets dialect attribute.

macros.name: LocaleSetRegionAttribute
macros.doc: Sets region attribute.

macros.name: LocaleShortDate
macros.doc: Get the short date for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleShortDateTime
macros.doc: Get the short date and time for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleShortDayName
macros.doc: Gets the abbreviated day of week name identified by the index 〈n〉 (0 for Monday, 1 for Tuesday, etc) in the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleShortTime
macros.doc: Get the short time for the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleStandaloneDayName
macros.doc: Gets the day of week name identified by the index 〈n〉 (0 for Monday, 1 for Tuesday, etc) in the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleStandaloneShortDayName
macros.doc: Gets the abbreviated day of week name identified by the index 〈n〉 (0 for Monday, 1 for Tuesday, etc) in the given dialect.

macros.name: LocaleSupportPackageCase
macros.doc: Provide a user-level command to determine whether babel or polyglossia was used.

macros.name: LocaleVariantName
macros.doc: Get the variant name of the given dialect according to the OS default language.

macros.name: LocaleVariantNativeName
macros.doc: Get the variant name of the given dialect according to that dialect.
